filter_by.description: Date-range filter in the form "<date_field>.<preset>". date_field must be TransactionDate (filters on transaction time) or AvailableDate (filters on the date payout funds become available - i.e. payout availability, maps to FUNDSAVAILABLEON). preset is one of: Today, ThisWeek, ThisMonth, ThisQuarter, ThisHalfYear, ThisYear, PreviousDay, PreviousWeek, PreviousMonth, PreviousQuarter, PreviousHalfYear, PreviousYear, CustomDate, Last_7_Days, Last_30_Days, Last_90_Days. Use from_date/to_date together with preset=CustomDate.

from_date.description: Start date for the filter_by date range (e.g. 2024-06-06). Required when filter_by is CustomDate.

to_date.description: End date for the filter_by date range (e.g. 2024-06-30). Required when filter_by is CustomDate.

can_show_convenience_fee_transactions.description: If true, restrict results to transactions that had a non-zero convenience fee charged.

card_brand.description: Filter by card brand: rupay, visa, union_pay, master_card, jcb, discover, diners, amex, others, or "all". Only applies when payment_method_type is card.

card_type.description: Filter by whether the card is domestic or international relative to the merchant's own edition/country: "domestic", "international", or "all". This is NOT the card funding type (credit/debit/prepaid) - it compares the card's issuing country to the merchant account's country. Only applies to card transactions.

filter_by.description: Date-range filter in the form "<date_field>.<preset>". date_field must be TransactionDate (filters on transaction time) or AvailableDate (filters on the date payout funds become available - i.e. payout availability, maps to FUNDSAVAILABLEON). preset is one of: Today, ThisWeek, ThisMonth, ThisQuarter, ThisHalfYear, ThisYear, PreviousDay, PreviousWeek, PreviousMonth, PreviousQuarter, PreviousHalfYear, PreviousYear, CustomDate, Last_7_Days, Last_30_Days, Last_90_Days. Use from_date/to_date together with preset=CustomDate.

from_date.description: Start date for the filter_by date range (e.g. 2024-06-06). Required when filter_by is CustomDate.

payment_method_type.description: Filter by payment method type: card, net_banking, ach_debit, upi, wallet, bank_transfer, apple_pay, or "all". Only applies to transaction types that carry a payment method (e.g. charge, refund).

payment_type.description: Filter by payment type: "online" (matches ecommerce and moto transactions), "in_person" (matches pos transactions), or "all".

reference_number.description: Filter by the reference number associated with the transaction (partial/contains match).

sort_column.description: Column to sort results by: transaction_time, amount, net_amount, fee, customer_name, available_on, or settled_time (default transaction_time).

to_date.description: End date for the filter_by date range (e.g. 2024-06-30). Required when filter_by is CustomDate.

transaction_id.description: Filter by a specific transaction identifier.

transaction_type.description: Filter by transaction type(s). Must be prefixed with the literal "TransactionType." followed by one or more comma-separated (up to 12) values: Charge, Charge_Reversal, Refund, Refund_Reversal, Payout, Payout_Reversal, Manual_Payout, Manual_Payout_Reversal, Chargeback, Chargeback_Fee, Chargeback_Reversal, Chargeback_Fee_Reversal, Adjustment (matches both credit and debit adjustments), Withdrawal, Withdrawal_Reversal, Reserve, Reserve_Released, Payment_Failure_Fee, Verification_Fee, Application_Fee, Application_Fee_Refund, Top_Up, Mandate_Creation_Fee, Network_Fee, Network_Fee_Refund - or "TransactionType.All" for every type.

fee_type.description: Filter by fee type: network_fee (scheme/interchange/network-side fees) or processor_fee (platform/processor-side fees).

filter_by.description: Date-range filter in the form "<date_field>.<preset>", REQUIRED for this operation. date_field must be TransactionDate or AvailableDate. preset is one of: Today, ThisWeek, ThisMonth, ThisQuarter, ThisHalfYear, ThisYear, PreviousDay, PreviousWeek, PreviousMonth, PreviousQuarter, PreviousHalfYear, PreviousYear, CustomDate, Last_7_Days, Last_30_Days, Last_90_Days. Use from_date/to_date together with preset=CustomDate.

from_date.description: Start date for the filter_by date range (e.g. 2024-06-06). Required when filter_by is CustomDate.

to_date.description: End date for the filter_by date range (e.g. 2024-06-30). Required when filter_by is CustomDate.
